risk.selection: top ceil(0.20*N) D_rank pixels per class

gates.G0: all integrity, parity, isolation, freeze, forward, and no-leakage assertions
gates.G1: lower95(class-bootstrap family matched-win) > 0.5 and supportive classes >= 10/15
gates.G2: lower95(paired family-minus-B1 matched-win) > 0 and positive classes >= 10/15
gates.G3: lower95(paired aligned-minus-shifted family win) > 0 and aligned-better classes >= 10/15
gates.G4: lower95(C_AP delta) > 0, lower95(R_pos delta) > 0, upper95(R_neg delta) <= 0

multiple_family_control.test: exact 2^15 paired class sign-flip test on OOF matched delta vs B1

selection.direction_count: correct-sign class outcomes across four metrics, maximum 48
selection.ranking: per-family normalized margins in [0,1]; lexicographic gate count, direction count, worst rank, mean rank, lower complexity rank, lexicographically smaller config id
